notes: Source OpenAPI remains unchanged. Missing operationIds are replaced by stable SDK registry names.
Optional non-nullable wire fields use None only as an absent-field default; explicit null is rejected. model_fields_set preserves presence.
Response enums preserve unknown strings. Public request enums and query parameters validate supported choices.
Offer create/update priceCents accept either integer strings or JSON integers, as the schema descriptions explicitly allow.
High-level target create requires GameID, title, amount and price despite sparse upstream required arrays.
High-level offer update requires offer_id and price. CreateOffer.price=None omits priceCents, preserving the server default.
USD prices normalize per endpoint. DMC balance is exposed as exact MinorMoney because the contract does not define its decimal scale.
All routes use a conservative shared global 5 RPS default. Specific upstream rate categories are not inferred from URL names.
P2P buy type is preserved from the wire contract, but API purchase availability remains unverified due to contradictory upstream descriptions.
Withdrawal requestId is retained but not assumed to guarantee server idempotency. Mutations are never automatically retried.
